source.scope: original MuseReal + WhisperASR + BaseAvatar offline render subset; not app.py, server, WebRTC network or livechat

policy.trim_pad_or_shift: none; emitted prefix/tail silence and batch boundaries are kept as captured

avatar.full_image_note: protected 512 RGB Mona Lisa crop reused byte-exact from the prior LivePortrait example; public-domain painting; full canvas for paste-back

capture_target_rule.basis: original put_audio_file emits floor(samples/320) 20 ms chunks at 16 kHz and drops an incomplete tail; BaseASR.warm_up leaves r silent chunks ahead of them in output_queue; each video frame carries 2 chunks; inference consumes whole batches
capture_target_rule.resampled_samples: measured at run time from the original BaseAvatar resampling of each WAV, not declared here

jobs.prior_tts_input_text: Please keep the back door closed while the heater is running. The spare keys are in the blue drawer by the sink.
Your train leaves from platform four at nine fifteen. Bring a printed ticket and arrive ten minutes early.

audio_provenance: both WAVs are earlier Chatterbox (MIT) original-English outputs with its built-in conditioning, reused byte-exact; no new TTS, recording or ASR here; this does not assert anything about Chatterbox training data
audio_role: functional input sound driving the original pipeline; not narration
comparison_note: two different utterances and lengths; not a controlled effect or quality comparison
